title: The Ear of the Beholder — Ypsilanti and General Motors
shortTitle: The Ear of the Beholder — Ypsilanti and General Motors
summary: A township granted industrial tax abatements after a plant presentation about new investment and continued employment, subject to favorable demand. General Motors later planned to transfer production.
notes:
